behaviors.description: Forward file arguments through a private document portal.
behaviors.preconditions: Private permission store/document portal executables and usable FUSE device.
behaviors.expected: Argument becomes document path; probe reads and writes host document; export disappears after portal restart.

behaviors.description: Replace application and runtime mounts and retain originals under parent mounts.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent reference checkouts with distinct added markers.
behaviors.expected: Replacement marker appears only under selected mount; original executable redirected; empty app-path omits app contents.

behaviors.description: Enforce absent, read-only and read-write host filesystem grants.
behaviors.expected: Ungrant read fails; ro read succeeds and write fails without host change; rw changes host bytes.
Probe writes exact content into newly created host directory.

behaviors.description: Revoke metadata and stored filesystem grants per run.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent host markers available through separate metadata-only and override-only grants.
behaviors.expected: Both readable controls become denied under host:reset and readable again on ordinary runs; stored deny/ro/rw/reset effects also checked.

behaviors.description: Persist a home-relative directory through run and override permissions.
behaviors.expected: Bytes survive separate runs and stored permission; host home-relative marker is absent.

mappings.rationale: Actual document-path replacement, read/write host effects, public document listing and nonpersistent export across private portal restart.
Independent replacement files and original executables observed inside sandbox.

surface_assertions.rationale: Replacement marker mounted at /app, original executable under /run/parent/app; empty value makes /app executable absent.
Replacement marker mounted at /usr while original runtime executable remains under /run/parent/usr.

mappings.rationale: Probe reads granted host bytes, ro write fails in probe and preserves host bytes, rw changes bytes.
Create-mode host directory and marker appear.

surface_assertions.rationale: Absent directory is created and receives exact sandbox-written content with :create.

mappings.rationale: Independent metadata-only and override-only paths are readable in controls, both denied by host:reset, and both restored on ordinary subsequent runs.

surface_assertions.rationale: Stored ro permits read but denies write; stored rw changes host bytes.
Stored explicit host path denial makes probe read fail.

mappings.rationale: Actual bytes survive separate launches without appearing in host home-relative directory.

surface_assertions.rationale: Home-relative marker persists across separate invocations with this permission.
Stored persist permission exposes prior marker and persists subsequent writes.
